card: Backports PR #36701 to the 32.x maintenance branch to disable ARM32 unit and functional tests in GitHub Actions CI, and updates the v32.x release notes. This eliminates flaky or problematic ARM32 test execution in CI on the release branch. The PR consists of two commits backporting already-merged master changes with no impact on node behavior.
evidence: PR description explicitly lists the single backport: "* #36701"
Commit 7c6fdd0a26 message: "ci: Disable tests on ARM32 in GHA yaml, Github-Pull: #36701"
problem: Running tests on emulated ARM32 in GitHub Actions CI is slow or unreliable, leading to CI failures and maintenance overhead on the 32.x branch.

risk.why: The PR only alters GitHub Actions CI test execution configuration and release notes documentation on a maintenance branch.

scope_notes: Although the PR contains only two commits backporting #36701 and updating release notes, the merge-base diff includes many unrelated files between master and the 32.x maintenance branch due to base branch configuration.
summary: Backports PR #36701 to the 32.x release branch to disable running unit and functional tests on ARM32 in GitHub Actions CI. It also updates the 32.x release notes.
